verified_facts: 1m composite DTM covers about 99 percent of England
DTM removes surface objects to model terrain surface
2022 composite combines Time Stamped archive and National LIDAR Programme surveys
repeat-survey selection uses the newest best-resolution data
resampled composite data uses bilinear interpolation
2022 composite source surveys span 6 June 2000 to 2 April 2022
metadata index catalogues identify which survey contributed at a location
time-stamped DTM is available at 25cm, 50cm, 1m and 2m depending on project
time-stamped DTM GeoTIFFs are supplied in 5km zip files
time-stamped data is referenced to Ordnance Survey Newlyn and aligned to OS Grid
EA LIDAR vertical accuracy is plus or minus 15cm RMSE
ground-truth points are independently surveyed at plus or minus 3cm RMSE and LIDAR QC requires less than plus or minus 15cm RMSE
quality_effect: Bind every elevation sample to bare-earth DTM, survey epoch, resolution, OS Grid/Newlyn datum and source lineage; ground truth is an independent QC reference and not a parcel-height substitute.
